title: A uniform gap in the periodic spin-one antiferromagnetic chain
exact_target: For the standard spin-one periodic Hamiltonian $H_L=sum_j$ $S_j\cdot S_{j+1}$ and even lengths L, is the ground state unique for all sufficiently large L and is the spectral gap bounded below by a strictly positive constant independent of L? Use $[S^a,S^b]=i$ $\epsilon _abc$ $S^c$ and $sum_a(S^a)^2=2$.
